instruction.text: Match the main clauses and subordinate clauses to make conditional sentences.

atoms.b: unless you have been asked to stand up.
atoms.sound: please remain seated unless you have been asked to stand up.
If it is raining, you will get wet.
Sasha will pay Paula back when she has the money.
Ben will only wear shorts when it is warm.

instruction.text: Match the main clauses and subordinate clauses to make conditional sentences.

atoms.b: unless they have finished their work.
atoms.sound: Pupils cannot have golden time unless they have finished their work.

atoms.a: Simon will only go to the park ...
atoms.b: if Tim is going to be there.
atoms.sound: Simon will only go to the park if Tim is going to be there.

atoms.b: when she has finished her dinner.
atoms.sound: Rachel can have cake when she has finished her dinner.

atoms.a: If Rita does well in her exams, ...
atoms.b: she will start university in September
atoms.sound: If Rita does well in her exams, she will start university in September.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct conjunction to complete the sentence.

atoms.a: ssml:<break time='500ms'/> Suzie was rich, she would buy a castle.
atoms.b: ((++If But)) Suzie was rich, she would buy a castle.

atoms.a: ssml: Alexa only takes an umbrella to work with her <break time='500ms'/> it is raining.
atoms.b: Alexa only takes an umbrella to work with her ((++when so)) it is raining.

atoms.a: ssml: I am going to wash the dishes <break time='500ms'/> my brother has already done them.
atoms.b: I am going to wash the dishes ((++unless if)) my brother has already done them.

atoms.a: ssml: <break time='500ms'/> I had a car, I would drive to see my grandparents.
atoms.b: ((++If Although)) I had a car, I would drive to see my grandparents.
